fields.date_eligible: yes, no, or unclear for 2020-01-01 through 2026-08-13 inclusive.
fields.eligible_document_type: yes, no, or unclear for a substantive scholarly contribution.
fields.evidence: One or two ordinary-language sentences tied to the retained record; required and not a long quotation.
fields.health_professions_education: yes, no, or unclear for a health-professions learner purpose.
fields.language_assessable: yes, no, or unclear for enough English evidence to judge eligibility.
fields.llm_explicit: yes, no, or unclear for an explicit large/generative language model.
fields.model_families: Semicolon-separated model families actually used, evaluated, or centrally examined.
fields.nts_domains: Semicolon-separated supported V2 NTS values; blank if unsupported.
fields.paper_id: Copy the neutral record ID exactly.
fields.possible_version_of: Other neutral record ID when a version relationship is suspected; otherwise blank. Never use this as an exclusion decision.
fields.primary_code: INCLUDE, one active exclusion code, or one uncertainty code.
fields.simulation_central: yes, no, or unclear for simulation being central.
fields.simulation_modalities: Semicolon-separated supported V2 modality values; blank if excluded or unsupported.
fields.specialty: Named specialty only when explicit; otherwise blank.

version_handling: Judge record eligibility first. possible_version_of is only a flag; publication versions are linked after record-level eligibility.
